entities.summary: Serbia is a sovereign nation in Southern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Belgrade. Official languages include Serbian. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 6.7 million. Area: 77,474 km². Comprehensive index for Serbia covering medieval Serbian Empire (Stefan Dušan 14th century), Battle of Kosovo 1389 (defeat to Ottomans, national mythology), Ottoman rule (1459-1804), Serbian Revolution 1804-35 (Karađorđe, Miloš Obrenović), Kingdom of Serbia, WWI (Black Hand, Sarajevo assassination 1914 triggered war, 1.1M Serbian dead ~28% of population), Kingdom of Yugoslavia 1918-41, WWII (Axis occupation, Partisans vs Chetniks), communist Yugoslavia (Tito 1945-80), Milošević era (1989-2000), Yugoslav Wars (Slovenia/Croatia/Bosnia 1991-95, Kosovo 1998-99), NATO bombing 1999, EU/Kosovo issues.
